messages:
Maria CSM: Quick heads-up — Nimbus Logistics confirmed onboarding 3 new teams (Search, Agents, Insights). They plan a phased rollout next month and estimate ~2-3x current token throughput. Asking about Dedicated vs burst capacity and enablement. Also: SSO + prod API keys still pending, they ran integration tests that hit 429s.

Olivia AE: Nice signal — this looks like a clear expansion opportunity. Renewal not due for a while, right? Any blockers we should surface for the commercial thread? :eyes:

Maria CSM: Renewal is ~11 months out. They want a priority SLA and a short training package. Immediate blockers: SCIM provisioning failing for org id 9842 (SSO), and rate-limit 429s during their integration tests.

Sam Support: FYI I pulled their logs — 429 spike aligns with tight client retry (no jitter). Suggested linear backoff 500ms -> 4s and added KB link: https://redwood.cloud/docs/rate-limits. Kept customer ticket SUP-762 open.

AJ Eng: For sustained 2-3x throughput, Dedicated is the most predictable route. Need their traffic profile: token seq len, p50/p95 latencies, and burst pattern. Maria, can you share sample traffic?

Maria CSM: They sent a sample CSV. Quick highlights: mostly ~512 tokens per call, peak 1200 reqs/min across teams during normal peak, load tests spiked to ~3500 rpm. Models are a mix (open gpt-like for chat + separate embeddings pipeline). I'll DM the CSV to @AJ Eng and @Ben SE.

Ben SE: We should propose a Dedicated pod with autoscale + prefix cache; quantization suggestions for embeddings. I'll draft a config + cost estimate. Happy to run a 1hr enablement workshop on model selection, batching, and KV cache.

Olivia AE: Please include a 2-week pilot clause in the commercial draft. Also loop in Finance for committed spend discount options. This could convert to a multi-team expansion deal.

deploy-bot: Capacity request CR-2026 created for Nimbus Logistics: requested +3 GPUs, autoscale window 08:00-20:00 UTC. Tracker: https://console.redwood.internal/capacity/CR-2026

Sam Support: SSO note: SCIM provisioning returns 409 on group sync. Reached out to their IdP admin, waiting confirm. Ticket SUP-762 updated with logs.

Maria CSM: @Ben SE @AJ Eng — can we have a target EOD on a proposed config & load sim so I can update the customer?

AJ Eng: I'll run a 3x load simulation using a batching profile and KV cache enabled, will post results here. ETA: EOD.

Ben SE: I'll schedule the enablement workshop for Tue 10am PT and draft an agenda (model mapping, batching, quantization, rollout checklist). Sending calendar invite now.

Olivia AE: I'll start the commercial draft and add the pilot + renewal touchpoints. Good expansion signal. :tada:

Maria CSM: Thanks everyone — I'll consolidate notes and reply with next steps (pilot, SSO remediation, capacity trial). Tracking as opportunity "expansion-opportunity" in CRM and tagging SUP-762 & CR-2026. cc @Sam Support for follow-up on SSO.

Sam Support: Acknowledged — I'll keep the ticket active and post any IdP updates here.

Ben SE: One quick ask — can we get their expected percent embeddings vs generation? A 60/40 split changes pod sizing. Maria, can you ask them in the reply?

Maria CSM: Will ask now in the reply email and include the pilot timeline.

Olivia AE: Great — sounds like we have alignment. I'll prep a short Exec one-pager for the account.

Maria CSM: Closing the loop — I'll update this thread after I hear back from their IdP and after AJ's sim. Thanks all :heart:
